results.name: refused command
results.detail: Persistent inline refusal; last applied value remained Balanced; Change Mentality enabled again.

results.name: end race
results.detail: Normal MM→TS→MV journey reached minute 89; paused request stayed Pending; resume/next live tick reached the whistle before application. Not applied, Balanced retained, report focused.

results.name: no match frame
results.detail: Waiting fixture remained non-live, score/clock withheld, all match actions disabled with persistent reason.

results.name: speed boundaries
results.detail: Mouse and keyboard reach 1×/10×; newly disabled Slower/Faster recover focus to Pause/Resume immediately. Pause retains rung.

results.name: live earlier feedback
results.detail: Keyboard-opened disclosure remains open and summary keeps focus over five live ticks; stays open across pause/resume and another tick. Timer not frozen by review=1.

results.name: dense feedback chronology
results.detail: Synthetic prior changes are seeded at the first live frame, minute 15; all 15 Applied timestamps are at or before the visible clock. Waiting state has no future Applied records.

results.name: score/statistics coherence
results.detail: Synthetic ordinary scenario finishes 2–1; unmodified unusual capture finishes 19–9. Each scoreboard agrees with its goals table; source types labelled explicitly.

results.name: full time while staging
results.detail: Unsubmitted chooser closed at full time; no change requested; report received focus.

results.name: image interaction coverage
results.detail: Exports both staged dialogs, live/paused Pending, Mentality plus substitution Applied and healthy live statistics, from exercised controls. Full-time Not applied and incomplete report disclosures exported by their existing fixtures.

results.name: starting copy
results.detail: One lock explanation; placeholder has no pitch markings crossing its text.

results.name: pitch presentation
results.detail: Raw restart/holder captions omitted; two goals, penalty/goal areas and Home-right/Away-left direction shown, matching fixed Stage-0 source convention.

results.name: full-time statistics proposal
results.detail: Statistics cannot be reopened at full time; an already-open panel remains visible. Report destination explicit. S0-G-008 remains the accepted behavior; H changes only its presentation, pending H image approval.

results.name: partial statistics and alignment
results.detail: Synthetic minute-18 possession 47/47 differs from final 51/43; numeric Home/Away headers and cells right-aligned.

results.name: S0-H-011 substitution mark
results.detail: Applied H14 marker keeps a 2px white outline and a 1.25× ↔ glyph; the legend names the white-outlined ↔ marker.

results.name: H substitution identities
results.detail: Bench labels 1–7 retain engine indices 0–6. Pending retains H4; Applied replaces it with H14 ↔, exactly matching feedback. 22 markers; consumed choices disappear. Explicitly illustrative, not an engine projection.

results.name: H refused substitution identities
results.detail: Refused replacement leaves original shirt, lineup and count intact.

results.name: S0-H-012 comparison tags
results.detail: Comparison marks the applied value Current and the dropdown value Requested; changing the dropdown moves only Requested, and the dialog repeats the current value.

results.name: H Mentality consistency
results.detail: Setup and live comparison expose all seven labels and identical source-owned consequence text; selected requested value remains separate from current value.

detail.detail: Pending, Applied, Refused and Not applied each carry their own text label and a distinct badge/bar treatment.

results.name: S0-H-009 status text
results.detail: Period, minute, speed and current Mentality render as unbordered, unfilled, non-focusable text; period/minute sit directly under the score.

results.name: S0-H-010 pseudo-locale coverage
results.detail: Header context, both dialogs, comparison summary/tags, scoreboard, rail, statistics and report strings are all bracketed in pseudo-locale; only the wordmark, numbers and shirt markers are exempt.

results.name: export isolation and PDF completeness
results.detail: All 23 exports restore temporary capture styles; each PDF has one page, matches its PNG extent, and includes every displayed statistics row label. Modal captures followed by live/full-time statistics are exercised on the same page.
